enabled.description: Whether Catenary is enabled for this workspace. When false in .catenary.toml, the entire session is disabled: no tools, no servers, no hooks, no database writes. Only meaningful in project config (.catenary.toml), ignored in user config.

server.description: Server definitions keyed by language ID (e.g., 'rust', 'python').

outline_threshold.description: Minimum line count for defensive outlines.

outline_suppress.description: Glob patterns whose outlines are suppressed from automatic display. Symbols remain available via into.

commands.description: Allowlist-based command filtering. Only explicitly allowed commands can be run.

client_enforcement_only.description: Deliberate opt-out of Catenary enforcement. No hint notification, no enforcement.

build.description: The project's build tool (e.g., 'make'). Always allowed.

allow.description: Commands the agent can run unconditionally.

pipeline.description: Commands allowed mid-pipeline only (denied at pipe position 0).

deny.description: Subcommand denylist within allowed commands. Each key is a command name, each value is an array of denied subcommands.

args.description: Arguments to pass to the command.

initialization_options.description: Initialization options to pass to the LSP server during the 'initialize' request.

env.description: Environment variables to set on the spawned server process. Variables are added to the inherited environment; if a key already exists, the config value wins.

settings.description: Server-specific settings returned in workspace/configuration responses. The TOML nesting mirrors the JSON the server expects. Catenary matches the 'section' path from configuration requests and returns the subtree.

min_severity.description: Minimum diagnostic severity to deliver to agents. When absent, all severities are delivered.

single_file.description: Whether this server supports single-file mode (tier 3). When true, the server may be spawned with rootUri: null for files outside all workspace roots.

file_patterns.description: Glob patterns to filter which files this server handles within its language. Matched against the filename (not path). Servers without file_patterns handle all files for their language.

suppress_symbol_kind.description: When true, glob output omits the SymbolKind prefix for symbols from this server. Useful for non-programming language servers where the symbol name already embeds structural context (e.g., H1:, CodeBlock:).
